atoms.name: FIFO, enqueue, dequeue
atoms.one_line: Add at the rear, remove from the front. First in, first out.

atoms.name: Circular array queue
atoms.one_line: Indices wrap with mod n. One slot stays empty to tell full from empty.

atoms.name: Linked-list queue
atoms.one_line: Head and tail pointers give O(1) at both ends. One rear pointer on a circular list also works.

atoms.name: Deque
atoms.one_line: Insert and remove at both ends.

atoms.name: Queue from stacks, stack from queues
atoms.one_line: Two stacks give a queue. Two queues give a stack.

atoms.name: Cost of an operation sequence
atoms.one_line: Count total work over n operations, not the worst single one.

atoms.name: Stack and queue together
atoms.one_line: Items pass between a stack and a queue. Trace both, one operation at a time.

atoms.name: Queue applications
atoms.one_line: BFS frontier, level order, Josephus, scheduling.

atoms.name: Python deque
atoms.one_line: collections.deque: append, popleft, appendleft, pop all O(1). list.pop(0) is O(n).

patterns.name: Trace a mixed stack and queue sequence
